When you do call it, the right move is often **hybrid**: scout inline first (list the files, find the channels, scope the diff) to discover the work-list, then call Workflow to pipeline over it. You don't need to know the shape before the *task* — only before the *orchestration step*.

Common single-phase workflows you can chain across turns:
- **Understand** — parallel readers over relevant subsystems → structured map
- **Design** — judge panel of N independent approaches → scored synthesis
- **Review** — dimensions → find → adversarially verify (the review-changes example)
- **Research** — multi-modal sweep → deep-read → synthesize
- **Migrate** — discover sites → transform each (worktree isolation) → verify

For larger work, run several in sequence — read each result before deciding the next phase. You stay in the loop; each workflow is one well-scoped fan-out.

**Ultracode.** When a system-reminder confirms ultracode is on, that opt-in is standing: author and run a workflow for every substantive task by default. The goal is the most exhaustive, correct answer you can produce — token cost is not a constraint. For multi-phase work (understand → design → implement → review), that often means several workflows in sequence — one per phase — so you stay in the loop between them. The quality patterns below (adversarial verify, multi-modal sweep, completeness critic, loop-until-dry) are the tools; pick what fits the task. Lean toward orchestrating with workflows and adversarially verifying your findings — unless the work is trivial or already verified. Solo only on conversational turns or trivial mechanical edits. When a reminder says ultracode is off, revert to the opt-in rule in the Workflow tool description.

Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first. Every invocation automatically persists its script to a file under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate on a workflow, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with `{scriptPath: "<path>"}` instead of resending the full script.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'find-flaky-tests',
    description: 'Find flaky tests and propose fixes',   // one-line, shown in permission dialog
    phases: [                                            // one entry per phase() call
      { title: 'Scan', detail: 'grep test logs for retries' },
      { title: 'Fix', detail: 'one agent per flaky test' },
    ],
  }
  // script body starts here — use agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()/log()
  phase('Scan')
  const flaky = await agent('grep CI logs for retry markers', {schema: FLAKY_SCHEMA})
  ...

The `meta` object must be a PURE LITERAL — no variables, function calls, spreads, or template interpolation. Required fields: `name`, `description`. Optional: `whenToUse` (shown in the workflow list), `phases`. Use the SAME phase titles in meta.phases as in phase() calls — titles are matched exactly; a phase() call with no matching meta entry just gets its own progress group. Add `model` to a phase entry when that phase uses a specific model override.

Script body hooks:
- agent(prompt: string, opts?: {label?: string, phase?: string, schema?: object, model?: string, effort?: string, isolation?: 'worktree', agentType?: string}): Promise<any> — spawn a subagent. Without schema, returns its final text as a string. With schema (a JSON Schema), the subagent is forced to call a StructuredOutput tool and agent() returns the validated object — no parsing needed. Returns null if the user skips the agent mid-run or the subagent dies on a terminal API error after retries (filter with .filter(Boolean)). opts.label overrides the display label. opts.phase explicitly assigns this agent to a progress group (use this inside pipeline()/parallel() stages to avoid races on the global phase() state — same phase string → same group box). opts.model overrides the model for this agent call. Default to omitting it — the agent inherits the main-loop model (the resolved session model), which is almost always correct. Only set it when you're highly confident a different tier fits the task; when unsure, omit. opts.effort overrides the reasoning effort for this agent call ('low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max') — omit to inherit the session effort; use 'low' for cheap mechanical stages and higher tiers only for the hardest verify/judge stages. opts.isolation: 'worktree' runs the agent in a fresh git worktree — EXPENSIVE (~200-500ms setup + disk per agent), use ONLY when agents mutate files in parallel and would otherwise conflict; the worktree is auto-removed if unchanged. opts.agentType uses a custom subagent type (e.g. 'general-purpose', 'code-reviewer') instead of the default workflow subagent — resolved from the same registry as the Agent tool; composes with schema (the custom agent's system prompt gets a StructuredOutput instruction appended).
- pipeline(items, stage1, stage2, ...): Promise<any[]> — run each item through all stages independently, NO barrier between stages. Item A can be in stage 3 while item B is still in stage 1. This is the DEFAULT for multi-stage work. Wall-clock = slowest single-item chain, not sum-of-slowest-per-stage. Every stage callback receives (prevResult, originalItem, index) — use originalItem/index in later stages to label work without threading context through stage 1's return value. A stage that throws drops that item to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- parallel(thunks: Array<() => Promise<any>>): Promise<any[]> — run tasks concurrently. This is a BARRIER: awaits all thunks before returning. A thunk that throws (or whose agent errors) resolves to `null` in the result array — the call itself never rejects, so `.filter(Boolean)` before using the results. Use ONLY when you genuinely need all results together.
- log(message: string): void — emit a progress message to the user (shown as a narrator line above the progress tree)
- phase(title: string): void — start a new phase; subsequent agent() calls are grouped under this title in the progress display
- args: any — the value passed as Workflow's `args` input, verbatim (undefined if not provided). Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values in the tool call, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — `args: ["a.ts", "b.ts"]`, not `args: "[\"a.ts\", ...]"` (a stringified list reaches the script as one string, so `args.filter`/`args.map` throw). Use this to parameterize named workflows — e.g. pass a research question, target path, or config object directly instead of via a side-channel file.
- budget: {total: number|null, spent(): number, remaining(): number} — the turn's token target from the user's "+500k"-style directive. `budget.total` is null if no target was set. `budget.spent()` returns output tokens spent this turn across the main loop and all workflows — the pool is shared, not per-workflow. `budget.remaining()` returns `max(0, total - spent())`, or `Infinity` if no target. The target is a HARD ceiling, not advisory: once `spent()` reaches `total`, further `agent()` calls throw. Use for dynamic loops: `while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) { ... }`, or static scaling: `const FLEET = budget.total ? Math.floor(budget.total / 100_000) : 5`.
- workflow(nameOrRef: string | {scriptPath: string}, args?: any): Promise<any> — run another workflow inline as a sub-step and return whatever it returns. Pass a name to invoke a saved workflow (same registry as {name: "..."}), or {scriptPath} to run a script file you Wrote earlier. The child shares this run's concurrency cap, agent counter, abort signal, and token budget — its agents appear under a "▸ name" group in /workflows and its tokens count toward budget.spent(). The args param becomes the child's `args` global. Nesting is one level only: workflow() inside a child throws. Throws on unknown name / unreadable scriptPath / child syntax error; catch to handle gracefully.

Subagents are told their final text IS the return value (not a human-facing message), so they return raw data. For structured output, use the schema option — validation happens at the tool-call layer so the model retries on mismatch.
Schemas need {type: 'object', properties: {...}} at root and required ⊆ properties; unsatisfiable ones throw at agent().

Workflow agents can reach all session-connected MCP tools via ToolSearch — schemas load on demand per agent. Caveat: interactively-authenticated MCP servers (e.g. claude.ai) may be absent in headless/cron runs.

Subagents get the same CLAUDE.md files injected at start that you did (except built-in agent types that omit them, such as Explore and Plan) — don't tell them to re-read those or paste their rules into the prompt; name the specific rule a stage needs, if any.

Scripts are plain JavaScript, NOT TypeScript — type annotations (`: string[]`), interfaces, and generics fail to parse. The script body runs in an async context — use await directly. Standard JS built-ins (JSON, Math, Array, etc.) are available — EXCEPT `Date.now()`/`Math.random()`/argless `new Date()`, which throw (they would break resume); pass timestamps in via `args`, stamp results after the workflow returns, and for randomness vary the agent prompt/label by index. No filesystem or Node.js API access.

DEFAULT TO pipeline(). Only reach for a barrier (parallel between stages) when you genuinely need ALL prior-stage results together.

A barrier is correct ONLY when stage N needs cross-item context from all of stage N-1:
- Dedup/merge across the full result set before expensive downstream work
- Early-exit if the total count is zero ("0 bugs found → skip verification entirely")
- Stage N's prompt references "the other findings" for comparison

A barrier is NOT justified by:
- "I need to flatten/map/filter first" — do it inside a pipeline stage: pipeline(items, stageA, r => transform([r]).flat(), stageB)
- "The stages are conceptually separate" — that's what pipeline() models. Separate stages ≠ synchronized stages.
- "It's cleaner code" — barrier latency is real. If 5 finders run and the slowest takes 3× the fastest, a barrier wastes 2/3 of the fast finders' idle time.

Smell test: if you wrote
  const a = await parallel(...)
  const b = transform(a)        // flatten, map, filter — no cross-item dependency
  const c = await parallel(b.map(...))
that middle transform doesn't need the barrier. Rewrite as a pipeline with the transform inside a stage. When in doubt: pipeline.

Concurrent agent() calls are capped at min(16, available CPUs - 2) per workflow — excess calls queue and run as slots free up. You can still pass 100 items to parallel()/pipeline() and they all complete; only ~10 run at any moment. Total agent count across a workflow's lifetime is capped at 1000 — a runaway-loop backstop set far above any real workflow. A single parallel()/pipeline() call accepts at most 4096 items; passing more is an explicit error, not a silent truncation.

When a barrier IS correct — dedup across all findings before expensive verification:
  const all = await parallel(DIMENSIONS.map(d => () => agent(d.prompt, {schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA})))
  const deduped = dedupeByFileAndLine(all.filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.findings))  // <-- genuinely needs ALL at once
  const verified = await parallel(deduped.map(f => () => agent(verifyPrompt(f), {schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})))

Loop-until-count pattern — accumulate to a target:
  const bugs = []
  while (bugs.length < 10) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length}/10 found`)
  }

Loop-until-budget pattern — scale depth to the user's "+500k" directive. Guard on budget.total: with no target set, remaining() is Infinity and the loop would run straight to the 1000-agent cap.
  const bugs = []
  while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length} found, ${Math.round(budget.remaining()/1000)}k remaining`)
  }

Composing patterns — exhaustive review (find → dedup vs seen → diverse-lens panel → loop-until-dry):
  const seen = new Set(), confirmed = []
  let dry = 0
  while (dry < 2) {                                              // loop-until-dry
    const found = (await parallel(FINDERS.map(f => () =>          // barrier: collect all finders this round
      agent(f.prompt, {phase: 'Find', schema: BUGS})))).filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.bugs)
    const fresh = found.filter(b => !seen.has(key(b)))           // dedup vs ALL seen — plain code, not an agent
    if (!fresh.length) { dry++; continue }
    dry = 0; fresh.forEach(b => seen.add(key(b)))
    const judged = await parallel(fresh.map(b => () =>           // every fresh bug judged concurrently...
      parallel(['correctness','security','repro'].map(lens => () =>   // ...each by 3 distinct lenses
        agent(`Judge "${b.desc}" via the ${lens} lens — real?`, {phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT})))
        .then(vs => ({ b, real: vs.filter(Boolean).filter(v => v.real).length >= 2 }))))
    confirmed.push(...judged.filter(v => v.real).map(v => v.b))
  }
  return confirmed
  // dedup vs `seen`, NOT `confirmed` — else judge-rejected findings reappear every round and it never converges.

Quality patterns — common shapes; pick by task and compose freely:
- Adversarial verify: spawn N independent skeptics per finding, each prompted to REFUTE. Kill if ≥majority refute. Prevents plausible-but-wrong findings from surviving.
    const votes = await parallel(Array.from({length: 3}, () => () =>
      agent(`Try to refute: ${claim}. Default to refuted=true if uncertain.`, {schema: VERDICT})))
    const survives = votes.filter(Boolean).filter(v => !v.refuted).length >= 2
- Perspective-diverse verify: when a finding can fail in more than one way, give each verifier a distinct lens (correctness, security, perf, does-it-reproduce) instead of N identical refuters — diversity catches failure modes redundancy can't.
- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

Scale to what the user asked for. "find any bugs" → a few finders, single-vote verify. "thoroughly audit this" or "be comprehensive" → larger finder pool, 3–5 vote adversarial pass, synthesis stage. When unsure, lean toward thoroughness for research/review/audit requests and toward brevity for quick checks.

These patterns aren't exhaustive — compose novel harnesses when the task calls for it (tournament brackets, self-repair loops, staged escalation, whatever fits).

Use this tool for multi-step orchestration where control flow should be deterministic (loops, conditionals, fan-out) rather than model-driven.

## Resume

The tool result includes a runId. To resume after a pause, kill, or script edit, relaunch with Workflow({scriptPath, resumeFromRunId}) — the longest unchanged prefix of agent() calls returns cached results instantly; the first edited/new call and everything after it runs live. Same script + same args → 100% cache hit. Before diagnosing why a completed workflow returned an empty or unexpected result, Read <transcriptDir>/journal.jsonl — it records each agent's actual return value; do not assume cached results are non-empty. Date.now()/Math.random()/new Date() are unavailable in scripts (they would break this) — stamp results after the workflow returns, or pass timestamps via args. Fallback when no journal is available: Read agent-<id>.jsonl files in the transcript directory and hand-author a continuation script.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

1	# SOLOTASK01 多租户密钥管理后端
2	
3	一个多租户密钥管理服务，同时提供 HTTP API 与命令行入口。支持 AES256 / RSA2048
4	密钥的生成、版本化轮换、吊销、加密导出/导入、租户级加密备份/恢复、按租户的
5	操作者策略、只追加的审计账，以及可插拔的 KMS/HSM 提供者。轮换/导入/恢复是
6	幂等变更：同一 `Idempotency-Key` 的重试只重放原结果，进程在任一步骤崩溃后
7	重启都能据 `operation_id` 判定是否已耐久并一致收尾。私钥只保存在服务端，
8	任何响应与审计投影都不含私钥、句柄或包装材料。
9	
10	## 依赖与安装
11	
12	Python 3.10+，仅一个运行时依赖：
13	
14	```bash
15	pip install -r requirements.txt   # cryptography>=3.4
16	```
17	
18	## 启动
19	
20	```bash
21	python -m keymgr --data-dir ./keymgr_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
22	```
23	
24	数据目录也可用环境变量 `KEYMGR_DATA_DIR` 指定（CLI 默认 `keymgr_data`）。
25	提供者由 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER` 选择（缺省或 `local` 为内置本地提供者，其它值为
26	`module:factory`，首次使用时才惰性加载，绝不回退本地）。
27	
28	## 基础测试
29	
30	```bash
31	python -m compileall -q keymgr
32	python3 -c "from keymgr.crypto import generate_key; generate_key('AES256'); generate_key('RSA2048')"
33	curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys \
34	  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
35	  -d '{"tenant_id":"a","algorithm":"AES256","label":"t"}'
36	```
37	
38	## 通用约定
39	
40	- 除 `serve` 外每个请求都需单一非空头 `X-Operator-Id: <operator>`（CLI 为
41	  必填 `--operator`）；缺失/为空/重复均 `400`（CLI 退出 `2`）。操作者既是
42	  审计主体也是策略 `subject`。
43	- 租户来源：单一 `X-Tenant-Id` 头或单一 `?tenant_id=` 参数；允许 body 携带
44	  `tenant_id` 的端点，头/参数/体必须一致。缺失、重复、冲突均 `400` 且错误指
45	  `tenant_id`，并记一条任何租户都不可见的 `tenant_conflict` 事件（幂等端点在
46	  幂等键绑定**之前**的参数/解析错误例外：不写任何审计、操作、密钥或句柄）。
47	- 错误 HTTP 状态与 CLI 退出码：`400→2`、`403→3`、`409→3`、`404→4`、
48	  `500/503→1`；成功 `0`。普通错误体仅 `{"error": ...}`；幂等变更的错误体仅
49	  `{"error", "operation_id"}`，成功体额外含 `operation_id`。
50	- `key_id` 为小写 UUID4，非法值是 `400`；未知对象与跨租户访问统一 `404`，
51	  不泄露存在性。
52	
53	## HTTP 接口
54	
55	- `POST /v1/keys`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm, label}`，`algorithm` 仅
56	  `AES256`/`RSA2048`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key}`（AES 的
57	  `public_key` 为 null，RSA 为 PEM）。
58	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` → `{algorithm, label, created_at, public_key}`。
59	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm}`，需
60	  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key,
61	  operation_id}`，版本严格递增、只追加。
62	- `POST /v1/keys/batch-rotate`，body
63	  `{tenant_id, items:[{key_id, algorithm}, ...]}`，需 `Idempotency-Key`。
64	  `items` 限 1–100 项，`key_id` 为不重复小写 UUID4，`algorithm` 仅
65	  AES256/RSA2048；任一非法 `400` 且在幂等键绑定**之前**零副作用（不写审计、
66	  操作、密钥或句柄）。按 `rotate` 授权：策略拒绝 `403`；任一 `key_id` 未知
67	  或属于其它租户则整批 `404`（不泄露跨租户存在性），皆零变更。`201` →
68	  `{items:[{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key}, ...], operation_id}`，
69	  items 严格按请求序；各 key 沿用单键 rotate 语义，整批原子提交（共享一把
70	  per-key 锁顺序、单一 provision/snapshot 记账、单条提交事件）。
71	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/versions/{version}` 与
72	  `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/current` →
73	  `{key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, public_key}`；version 须为正整数。
74	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke`，body `{tenant_id, reason, operator}` →
75	  `{key_id, status, reason, operator, revoked_at}`；重复/并发吊销幂等，保留
76	  首次值。
77	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/status`：字段同 revoke；active 时后三项为 null。
78	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/export`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
79	  `{format:"keymgr-export-v1", bundle}`，bundle 为不透明 base64（scrypt +
80	  AES-256-GCM，`format` 作为 AAD）。
81	- `POST /v1/keys/import`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
82	  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key, operation_id}`，
83	  保留原 key_id、全部版本、label、current 与吊销状态。同租户已有 key_id 为
84	  `409`，key_id 被其它租户占用为 `404`；口令/篡改/格式错误为 `400` 且不占用
85	  幂等键。
86	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/encrypt`，body
87	  `{tenant_id, version?, plaintext, aad?}`；`plaintext`、`aad` 为 base64，
88	  `version` 缺省为 current。`200` →
89	  `{format:"keymgr-envelope-v1", envelope}`，`envelope` 为 base64，内含
90	  key_id、version、算法、nonce/tag、密文及**包装后的数据密钥**：每次生成新
91	  的 256 位数据密钥，以 AES-256-GCM 加密明文；AES256 版本用 AES-GCM 包装数
92	  据密钥，RSA2048 版本用 RSA-OAEP-SHA256 包装。
93	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/decrypt`，body `{tenant_id, envelope, aad?}`，接
94	  受 `keymgr-envelope-v1`。`200` → `{plaintext}`（base64）。信封内 key_id
95	  必须与路径一致；缺字段、非法 base64、篡改、AAD 不符为 `400` 且错误指明
96	  字段；未知或跨租户的 key/version 为 `404`；吊销版本（含旧版本）为 `409`；
97	  提供者不可用为 `503`，沿用固定脱敏文案。私钥、数据密钥只存在于进程内存，
98	  绝不进入响应或审计。
99	- `POST /v1/backup`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
100	  `{format:"tenant-backup-v1", bundle}`；载荷
101	  `{format, tenant_id, keys, policy}`，空租户为 `keys:[]、policy:null`。
102	- `POST /v1/restore`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
103	  `Idempotency-Key`。校验顺序：参数/解密/格式 `400` → 授权 `403` → 包内
104	  tenant 不符 `404` → 同租户 key_id/策略冲突 `409`（绝不覆盖既有策略）→
105	  多文件原子恢复 `201` → `{tenant_id, key_ids, policy_restored,
106	  operation_id}`。空包同样成功（`key_ids:[]`、`policy_restored:false`）。
107	- `GET /v1/policy` / `PUT /v1/policy` / `DELETE /v1/policy`：读/替换/删除
108	  租户策略，见下。
109	- `GET /v1/audit`：本租户审计查询，见下。
110	- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：查询幂等操作，见下。
111	
112	## 幂等操作
113	
114	- rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate（CLI：
115	  `rotate`/`import`/`restore`/`batch-rotate`）必须携带**单一**
116	  `Idempotency-Key` 头（CLI 必填 `--idempotency-key`），值为 1–128 个
117	  `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` 字符。缺失、为空、重复、非法一律 `400`（CLI `2`），且该
118	  校验先于请求体读取与一切业务：不写审计、操作记录、密钥或提供者句柄。
119	- 键全局唯一，绑定记录 `operation_id`(UUID4)、租户、操作者、路径、规范化体
120	  （键排序紧凑 JSON）、状态、HTTP 状态与响应；存于 `operations/<id>.json`
121	  (0600) 与 `operations/index.json`，进程内锁 + `operations.lock` 的 fcntl
122	  排他锁串行化。
123	- 相同绑定重试：直接重放首次状态码、响应体与审计事件（同一
124	  `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次）。同键不同绑定：`409`（CLI `3`），错误
125	  体给出已有 `operation_id`。绑定前的导入/恢复解密无副作用：口令错误 `400`
126	  不占用该键。
127	- 状态：`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed`/`conflict`/`timed_out`。成功为 `201`
128	  succeeded；同租户冲突为 `409` conflict；`403/404/400` 与提供者/账本失败为
129	  failed（保留原状态码）。并发同键仅一个执行，其余等待；等待超 5 秒返回
130	  `503` timed_out（CLI `1`），等待方不写任何东西。
131	- 多/单轮换互斥：批量轮换与单键 rotate 都按 `key_id` 排序获取 per-key
132	  进程内锁 + `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 排他锁（整批共享一个 5 秒截止时刻）。对同一
133	  key 的并发变更要么全在批量之前、要么全在之后；等待同一被占 key 超过 5 秒的
134	  批量返回 `503` timed_out 且零副作用（此时尚无 journal、事件或句柄）。
135	- `operation_id` 即该变更审计事件的 `event_id`，因此每个终态至多一条事件，
136	  HTTP 与 CLI 共用同一套记录，可跨入口用相同键重放或按 id 查询。
137	- **崩溃一致性**：进程可在绑定、outbox 落盘、账本追加或清理任一步骤崩溃。
138	  重启（或任一 CLI 入口）在 key/restore outbox 恢复之后，按同一
139	  `operation_id` 判定：事件已入帐即已提交，据耐久事实重建原 `201`/`403`/
140	  `404`/`409` 响应与审计投影并置终态（拒绝终态的状态码随事件持久化，严格
141	  重放）；事件未入帐则置 failed(`500`)，半成品文件、提供者句柄与标记由
142	  outbox/provision 恢复回滚。不重复记账（账本按 event_id 去重），不误判。
143	- **operation 工件镜像**：rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate 在幂等键绑定
144	  记录耐久**之后**、首次调用提供者**之前**，原子创建
145	  `operation-artifacts/<operation_id>.json`（0600、temp 文件 fsync 后 rename；
146	  非幂等入口与未绑定请求不创建该目录）。镜像是一次尝试全部耐久工件的交叉
147	  索引，记录租户、操作者、路径、规范化请求体、`kind`/审计动作、完整写集
148	  （rotate/import 为该 key_id，batch 为全部 key_id，restore 为全部新建
149	  key_id 及是否含策略）、阶段（`bound`→`provisioning`→`staged`→
150	  `committed`/`rolled_back`）、`provisions/<id>.json` 引用（batch 另引用
151	  `batch-rotations/<id>.json`，空 restore 另记录其 `restore-empty-*`
152	  标记）以及每铸一个句柄即登记的新句柄 `provider_id`/`handle`；镜像与 journal
153	  条目同步落盘，二者永不矛盾。请求到达终态后：事件确认且 action/tenant/
154	  operation 一致、写集文件拥有全部新句柄且 journal/snapshot 已清，才删镜像
155	  并保留新版本；事件未入账时，先由 outbox 恢复幂等删除全部新句柄并恢复可信
156	  旧写集，证据清零才删镜像。账本不可读、提交不确定（同 id 事件 action/tenant
157	  不符）、镜像缺失/损坏、镜像与 `operations/<id>.json` 绑定不一致、引用缺失/
158	  不一致或 batch snapshot 损坏时，**保留整组证据**（镜像、标记、journal、
159	  snapshot 与句柄），不猜测回滚也不暴露未提交 current：该 operation 保持
160	  `pending`，请求/重启返回 `500`/`503` 等待下次重试。无镜像的旧 journal 与旧
161	  restore 标记沿用原有恢复规则，镜像从不强制存在。
162	- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：需单一操作者与单一租户来源；操作须
163	  同时属于该租户与操作者，否则一律 `404`。`200` →
164	  `{operation_id, tenant_id, status, http_status, response}`，pending 时后两
165	  项为 null。CLI：`operation --tenant-id --operator --operation-id`。
166	
167	## 策略
168	
169	- `GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/policy`，租户由单一头或单一参数提供（PUT 也可由 body
170	  的 `tenant_id` 提供，来源须一致）。GET → `{tenant_id, rules}`（无策略
171	  `404`）；PUT body `{tenant_id, rules}` 整体替换；DELETE 幂等，→
172	  `{tenant_id, deleted:true}`。
173	- 规则元素 `{subject, actions, effect}`：`subject` 为区分大小写的非空字符串；
174	  `actions` 为非空数组，取值
175	  `create/read/rotate/revoke/import/export/encrypt/decrypt/audit`，单条内
176	  重复去重；`effect` 为 `allow`/`deny`；未知字段、类型错误、同
177	  subject+effect+无序动作集的重复规则均 `400`；`rules:[]` 合法（全拒绝）。
178	- 执行：管理动作 policy_* 免检；租户无策略时全部允许；有策略时匹配规则中
179	  deny 优先于 allow，无匹配则拒绝 → `403`，并记一条原动作名、
180	  `outcome=rejected`、携带当时已知 `key_id` 的事件（create/解密前的 import/
181	  audit 查询为 null）。参数校验先于授权，授权先于存在性判断。
182	
183	## 审计
184	
185	- 事件字段 `{event_id, tenant_id, action, key_id, outcome, timestamp}`；
186	  `action` 为 `create/read/rotate/batch_rotate/revoke/import/export/
187	  encrypt/decrypt/audit/tenant_conflict/policy_read/policy_update/
188	  policy_delete`，`outcome` 为 `success/rejected`。信封加密/解密事件只含
189	  元数据（无 plaintext、aad、envelope、数据密钥或私钥）；策略拒绝写一条
190	  对应 `encrypt`/`decrypt` 的 rejected 事件（携带 key_id），成功写对应
191	  action 的 success 事件。备份记 `export`、恢复记 `import`，两者 `key_id`
192	  均为 null；恢复的所有事件（含成功）`key_id` 为 null；批量轮换整批至多
193	  一条 `batch_rotate` 事件，成功与拒绝终态的 `key_id` 均为 null，可按
194	  `action=batch_rotate` 筛选。
195	- `GET /v1/audit`：单一租户来源；可选 `key_id`(UUID4)、`action`、
196	  `limit`(1–1000，默认 100)、`cursor`。→ `{events, next_cursor}`，按
197	  (timestamp, event_id) 升序；游标为 HMAC 签名令牌，绑定租户/筛选/快照，
198	  被篡改或条件变化为 `400`。查询成功不记账，被策略拒绝才记一条
199	  `audit/rejected`（key_id null）。
200	- 账本为数据目录 `audit.log`（每行一个 JSON，只追加，进程内锁 +
201	  `audit.log.lock` fcntl 串行并 fsync，seq 单调）。变更走 outbox 事务：密钥
202	  /策略文件先携带待提交事件原子落盘 → 耐久追加账本（提交点）→ 清标记；账本
203	  失败回滚文件并删除本次新建句柄，返回 `500`（CLI `1`）；崩溃后启动按标记/
204	  event_id 幂等补记或回滚，不重不漏。恢复是多文件 outbox（标记带
205	  `"_restore":true` 与写集清单），只追加一条 `import` 事件；批量轮换是多
206	  key outbox（标记带 `"_batch_rotate":true`、写集 key_ids 与 provision/
207	  snapshot 引用），只追加一条 `batch_rotate` 事件（`key_id` null）。
208	
209	## 命令行
210	
211	所有子命令除 `serve` 外都需 `--operator`，租户命令需 `--tenant-id`；输出为
212	单行 JSON，字段与对应 HTTP 响应一致。
213	
214	```bash
215	# 密钥
216	python -m keymgr gen      --tenant-id t --algorithm RSA2048 --label k --operator alice
217	python -m keymgr show     --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
218	python -m keymgr current  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
219	python -m keymgr version  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --version 1 --operator alice
220	python -m keymgr rotate   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --algorithm AES256 \
221	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key rotate-0001
222	python -m keymgr batch-rotate --tenant-id t --operator alice \
223	                          --idempotency-key batch-0001 \
224	                          --items '[{"key_id":"<id1>","algorithm":"AES256"},{"key_id":"<id2>","algorithm":"RSA2048"}]'
225	python -m keymgr revoke   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --reason r --operator alice
226	python -m keymgr status   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
227	# 导出/导入、备份/恢复
228	python -m keymgr export   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --passphrase pw --operator alice
229	# 信封加密/解密（plaintext/aad 为 base64，version 缺省 current）
230	python -m keymgr encrypt  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> \
231	                          --plaintext <base64> [--aad <base64>] [--version 1] \
232	                          --operator alice
233	python -m keymgr decrypt  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> \
234	                          --envelope <keymgr-envelope-v1-base64> [--aad <base64>] \
235	                          --operator alice
236	python -m keymgr import   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
237	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key import-0001
238	python -m keymgr backup   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --operator alice
239	python -m keymgr restore  --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
240	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key restore-0001
241	# 审计 / 操作 / 策略
242	python -m keymgr audit    --tenant-id t --action rotate --limit 100 --operator alice
243	python -m keymgr operation --tenant-id t --operator alice --operation-id <id>
244	python -m keymgr policy --operator admin set|show|delete --tenant-id t [--rules '<json>']
245	```
246	
247	## KMS/HSM 提供者
248	
249	- 工厂返回对象须有非空 `provider_id`、`capabilities`
250	  （algorithms 含 AES256/RSA2048；operations 含
251	  generate/rotate/import_material/export_material/delete）及这五个方法。
252	  generate/rotate/import_material → `{handle, public_key, encrypted_material}`；
253	  export_material(handle) → `{public_key, encrypted_material}`；delete(handle)
254	  幂等。模块缺失/工厂失败/契约不符/后端异常一律 `503`（CLI `1`），固定文案
255	  "key management provider is unavailable"，绝不回退；导入材料不符算法（AES
256	  非 32 字节、RSA 公私钥不匹配等）为 `400`，错误只指名字段。
257	- 本地提供者用 `local.dek`(0600) 以 AES-256-GCM 包装材料，句柄与包装材料登
258	  记在 `local-registry.json`(0600)；密钥文件每个版本只存
259	  `{provider_id, handle, encrypted_material}` 三元组，导出包/备份包版本额外
260	  带 `provider` 来源块，旧 `keymgr-export-v1` 包无来源块时按本地处理。
261	- 轮换/导出/导入/恢复必须命中记录登记的 provider：记录属于未激活提供者，或
262	  导入/恢复来源块与当前提供者不符，均 `503`，不静默切换。
263	- 启动时安全扫描旧记录：仅当本地提供者活动时，把裸 `private_material`/空句
264	  柄的旧版本校验并包装为本地对象，先包装后原子重写，失败保持原文件字节不
265	  变（新建句柄随即释放，不影响启动）；配置了外部提供者时启动与普通读取既不
266	  加载提供者也不改写旧记录（此类记录在导出/轮换时 `503`）。
267	
268	## 持久化与限制
269	
270	- 每个密钥为数据目录下 `<key_id>.json`（0600，fsync + 原子 rename），含
271	  append-only `versions` 与 `current_version`；轮换在 per-key 进程内锁 +
272	  `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 锁下读改写，并发不丢版本、不悬指针。
273	- 导入/恢复/批量轮换在提供者调用前先建按 event_id 命名的 provision journal
274	  （首行耐久记录 operation_id、租户与动作，每铸一个句柄即以 0600 原子重写登记
275	  provider_id 与句柄）；提交后句柄归记录所有并删除 journal，未提交（冲突、
276	  提供者故障、账本失败、崩溃）则幂等删除全部已铸句柄，不留孤儿后端对象。恢复
277	  依据 journal 头校验账本中同 id 事件确属本次操作（动作、租户一致）才判定已
278	  提交；不一致即保留全部现场等待处理。批量
279	  轮换另在 `batch-rotations/<event_id>.json` 耐久记录每个 key 轮换前的整文件
280	  字节（snapshot），未提交时据此把整组文件还原；snapshot 缺失则整组保留等待下
281	  次启动，绝不猜测改写。
282	- 旧 restore 记录可能没有 provision journal：未提交回滚时以 `_restore` 标记
283	  的密钥文件列出整组句柄；提供者不可达或任一句柄删除失败时，保留整组密钥文件、
284	  策略文件与标记，下一次启动重试，全部句柄确认删除后才移除整组文件。
285	- 私钥与口令只存在于口令加密的包内或经提供者包装后的记录中；游标 HMAC 密钥
286	  存于 `audit.secret`(0600)。材料不会出现在任何响应、审计投影或错误信息中。
287	- rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate 另有 0600 的 operation 工件镜像
288	  `operation-artifacts/<operation_id>.json`：绑定后、调用提供者前创建，交叉
289	  关联 `operations/<id>.json`、`provisions/<id>.json`、restore 标记（含空
290	  restore 标记）或 batch snapshot，记录租户/操作者/路径/规范请求/动作/写集/
291	  阶段及新句柄；确认提交并核对句柄归属后随 journal/snapshot 一并清理，未提交
292	  时待全部新句柄删除、旧写集恢复后清理，任何证据缺失或不一致则整组保留（详见
293	  “幂等操作”一节）。
294

# SOLOTASK01 多租户密钥管理后端

一个多租户密钥管理服务，同时提供 HTTP API 与命令行入口。支持 AES256 / RSA2048
密钥的生成、版本化轮换、吊销、加密导出/导入、租户级加密备份/恢复、按租户的
操作者策略、只追加的审计账，以及可插拔的 KMS/HSM 提供者。轮换/导入/恢复是
幂等变更：同一 `Idempotency-Key` 的重试只重放原结果，进程在任一步骤崩溃后
重启都能据 `operation_id` 判定是否已耐久并一致收尾。私钥只保存在服务端，
任何响应与审计投影都不含私钥、句柄或包装材料。

## 依赖与安装

Python 3.10+，仅一个运行时依赖：

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt   # cryptography>=3.4
```

## 启动

```bash
python -m keymgr --data-dir ./keymgr_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

数据目录也可用环境变量 `KEYMGR_DATA_DIR` 指定（CLI 默认 `keymgr_data`）。
提供者由 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER` 选择（缺省或 `local` 为内置本地提供者，其它值为
`module:factory`，首次使用时才惰性加载，绝不回退本地）。

## 基础测试

```bash
python -m compileall -q keymgr
python3 -c "from keymgr.crypto import generate_key; generate_key('AES256'); generate_key('RSA2048')"
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"a","algorithm":"AES256","label":"t"}'
```

## 通用约定

- 除 `serve` 外每个请求都需单一非空头 `X-Operator-Id: <operator>`（CLI 为
  必填 `--operator`）；缺失/为空/重复均 `400`（CLI 退出 `2`）。操作者既是
  审计主体也是策略 `subject`。
- 租户来源：单一 `X-Tenant-Id` 头或单一 `?tenant_id=` 参数；允许 body 携带
  `tenant_id` 的端点，头/参数/体必须一致。缺失、重复、冲突均 `400` 且错误指
  `tenant_id`，并记一条任何租户都不可见的 `tenant_conflict` 事件（幂等端点在
  幂等键绑定**之前**的参数/解析错误例外：不写任何审计、操作、密钥或句柄）。
- 错误 HTTP 状态与 CLI 退出码：`400→2`、`403→3`、`409→3`、`404→4`、
  `500/503→1`；成功 `0`。普通错误体仅 `{"error": ...}`；幂等变更的错误体仅
  `{"error", "operation_id"}`，成功体额外含 `operation_id`。
- `key_id` 为小写 UUID4，非法值是 `400`；未知对象与跨租户访问统一 `404`，
  不泄露存在性。

## HTTP 接口

- `POST /v1/keys`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm, label}`，`algorithm` 仅
  `AES256`/`RSA2048`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key}`（AES 的
  `public_key` 为 null，RSA 为 PEM）。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` → `{algorithm, label, created_at, public_key}`。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key,
  operation_id}`，版本严格递增、只追加。
- `POST /v1/keys/batch-rotate`，body
  `{tenant_id, items:[{key_id, algorithm}, ...]}`，需 `Idempotency-Key`。
  `items` 限 1–100 项，`key_id` 为不重复小写 UUID4，`algorithm` 仅
  AES256/RSA2048；任一非法 `400` 且在幂等键绑定**之前**零副作用（不写审计、
  操作、密钥或句柄）。按 `rotate` 授权：策略拒绝 `403`；任一 `key_id` 未知
  或属于其它租户则整批 `404`（不泄露跨租户存在性），皆零变更。`201` →
  `{items:[{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key}, ...], operation_id}`，
  items 严格按请求序；各 key 沿用单键 rotate 语义，整批原子提交（共享一把
  per-key 锁顺序、单一 provision/snapshot 记账、单条提交事件）。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/versions/{version}` 与
  `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/current` →
  `{key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, public_key}`；version 须为正整数。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke`，body `{tenant_id, reason, operator}` →
  `{key_id, status, reason, operator, revoked_at}`；重复/并发吊销幂等，保留
  首次值。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/status`：字段同 revoke；active 时后三项为 null。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/export`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
  `{format:"keymgr-export-v1", bundle}`，bundle 为不透明 base64（scrypt +
  AES-256-GCM，`format` 作为 AAD）。
- `POST /v1/keys/import`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key, operation_id}`，
  保留原 key_id、全部版本、label、current 与吊销状态。同租户已有 key_id 为
  `409`，key_id 被其它租户占用为 `404`；口令/篡改/格式错误为 `400` 且不占用
  幂等键。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/encrypt`，body
  `{tenant_id, version?, plaintext, aad?}`；`plaintext`、`aad` 为 base64，
  `version` 缺省为 current。`200` →
  `{format:"keymgr-envelope-v1", envelope}`，`envelope` 为 base64，内含
  key_id、version、算法、nonce/tag、密文及**包装后的数据密钥**：每次生成新
  的 256 位数据密钥，以 AES-256-GCM 加密明文；AES256 版本用 AES-GCM 包装数
  据密钥，RSA2048 版本用 RSA-OAEP-SHA256 包装。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/decrypt`，body `{tenant_id, envelope, aad?}`，接
  受 `keymgr-envelope-v1`。`200` → `{plaintext}`（base64）。信封内 key_id
  必须与路径一致；缺字段、非法 base64、篡改、AAD 不符为 `400` 且错误指明
  字段；未知或跨租户的 key/version 为 `404`；吊销版本（含旧版本）为 `409`；
  提供者不可用为 `503`，沿用固定脱敏文案。私钥、数据密钥只存在于进程内存，
  绝不进入响应或审计。
- `POST /v1/backup`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
  `{format:"tenant-backup-v1", bundle}`；载荷
  `{format, tenant_id, keys, policy}`，空租户为 `keys:[]、policy:null`。
- `POST /v1/restore`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。校验顺序：参数/解密/格式 `400` → 授权 `403` → 包内
  tenant 不符 `404` → 同租户 key_id/策略冲突 `409`（绝不覆盖既有策略）→
  多文件原子恢复 `201` → `{tenant_id, key_ids, policy_restored,
  operation_id}`。空包同样成功（`key_ids:[]`、`policy_restored:false`）。
- `GET /v1/policy` / `PUT /v1/policy` / `DELETE /v1/policy`：读/替换/删除
  租户策略，见下。
- `GET /v1/audit`：本租户审计查询，见下。
- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：查询幂等操作，见下。

## 幂等操作

- rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate（CLI：
  `rotate`/`import`/`restore`/`batch-rotate`）必须携带**单一**
  `Idempotency-Key` 头（CLI 必填 `--idempotency-key`），值为 1–128 个
  `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` 字符。缺失、为空、重复、非法一律 `400`（CLI `2`），且该
  校验先于请求体读取与一切业务：不写审计、操作记录、密钥或提供者句柄。
- 键全局唯一，绑定记录 `operation_id`(UUID4)、租户、操作者、路径、规范化体
  （键排序紧凑 JSON）、状态、HTTP 状态与响应；存于 `operations/<id>.json`
  (0600) 与 `operations/index.json`，进程内锁 + `operations.lock` 的 fcntl
  排他锁串行化。
- 相同绑定重试：直接重放首次状态码、响应体与审计事件（同一
  `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次）。同键不同绑定：`409`（CLI `3`），错误
  体给出已有 `operation_id`。绑定前的导入/恢复解密无副作用：口令错误 `400`
  不占用该键。
- 状态：`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed`/`conflict`/`timed_out`。成功为 `201`
  succeeded；同租户冲突为 `409` conflict；`403/404/400` 与提供者/账本失败为
  failed（保留原状态码）。并发同键仅一个执行，其余等待；等待超 5 秒返回
  `503` timed_out（CLI `1`），等待方不写任何东西。
- 多/单轮换互斥：批量轮换与单键 rotate 都按 `key_id` 排序获取 per-key
  进程内锁 + `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 排他锁（整批共享一个 5 秒截止时刻）。对同一
  key 的并发变更要么全在批量之前、要么全在之后；等待同一被占 key 超过 5 秒的
  批量返回 `503` timed_out 且零副作用（此时尚无 journal、事件或句柄）。
- `operation_id` 即该变更审计事件的 `event_id`，因此每个终态至多一条事件，
  HTTP 与 CLI 共用同一套记录，可跨入口用相同键重放或按 id 查询。
- **崩溃一致性**：进程可在绑定、outbox 落盘、账本追加或清理任一步骤崩溃。
  重启（或任一 CLI 入口）在 key/restore outbox 恢复之后，按同一
  `operation_id` 判定：事件已入帐即已提交，据耐久事实重建原 `201`/`403`/
  `404`/`409` 响应与审计投影并置终态（拒绝终态的状态码随事件持久化，严格
  重放）；事件未入帐则置 failed(`500`)，半成品文件、提供者句柄与标记由
  outbox/provision 恢复回滚。不重复记账（账本按 event_id 去重），不误判。
- **operation 工件镜像**：rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate 在幂等键绑定
  记录耐久**之后**、首次调用提供者**之前**，原子创建
  `operation-artifacts/<operation_id>.json`（0600、temp 文件 fsync 后 rename；
  非幂等入口与未绑定请求不创建该目录）。镜像是一次尝试全部耐久工件的交叉
  索引，记录租户、操作者、路径、规范化请求体、`kind`/审计动作、完整写集
  （rotate/import 为该 key_id，batch 为全部 key_id，restore 为全部新建
  key_id 及是否含策略）、阶段（`bound`→`provisioning`→`staged`→
  `committed`/`rolled_back`）、`provisions/<id>.json` 引用（batch 另引用
  `batch-rotations/<id>.json`，空 restore 另记录其 `restore-empty-*`
  标记）以及每铸一个句柄即登记的新句柄 `provider_id`/`handle`；镜像与 journal
  条目同步落盘，二者永不矛盾。请求到达终态后：事件确认且 action/tenant/
  operation 一致、写集文件拥有全部新句柄且 journal/snapshot 已清，才删镜像
  并保留新版本；事件未入账时，先由 outbox 恢复幂等删除全部新句柄并恢复可信
  旧写集，证据清零才删镜像。账本不可读、提交不确定（同 id 事件 action/tenant
  不符）、镜像缺失/损坏、镜像与 `operations/<id>.json` 绑定不一致、引用缺失/
  不一致或 batch snapshot 损坏时，**保留整组证据**（镜像、标记、journal、
  snapshot 与句柄），不猜测回滚也不暴露未提交 current：该 operation 保持
  `pending`，请求/重启返回 `500`/`503` 等待下次重试。无镜像的旧 journal 与旧
  restore 标记沿用原有恢复规则，镜像从不强制存在。
- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：需单一操作者与单一租户来源；操作须
  同时属于该租户与操作者，否则一律 `404`。`200` →
  `{operation_id, tenant_id, status, http_status, response}`，pending 时后两
  项为 null。CLI：`operation --tenant-id --operator --operation-id`。

## 策略

- `GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/policy`，租户由单一头或单一参数提供（PUT 也可由 body
  的 `tenant_id` 提供，来源须一致）。GET → `{tenant_id, rules}`（无策略
  `404`）；PUT body `{tenant_id, rules}` 整体替换；DELETE 幂等，→
  `{tenant_id, deleted:true}`。
- 规则元素 `{subject, actions, effect}`：`subject` 为区分大小写的非空字符串；
  `actions` 为非空数组，取值
  `create/read/rotate/revoke/import/export/encrypt/decrypt/audit`，单条内
  重复去重；`effect` 为 `allow`/`deny`；未知字段、类型错误、同
  subject+effect+无序动作集的重复规则均 `400`；`rules:[]` 合法（全拒绝）。
- 执行：管理动作 policy_* 免检；租户无策略时全部允许；有策略时匹配规则中
  deny 优先于 allow，无匹配则拒绝 → `403`，并记一条原动作名、
  `outcome=rejected`、携带当时已知 `key_id` 的事件（create/解密前的 import/
  audit 查询为 null）。参数校验先于授权，授权先于存在性判断。

## 审计

- 事件字段 `{event_id, tenant_id, action, key_id, outcome, timestamp}`；
  `action` 为 `create/read/rotate/batch_rotate/revoke/import/export/
  encrypt/decrypt/audit/tenant_conflict/policy_read/policy_update/
  policy_delete`，`outcome` 为 `success/rejected`。信封加密/解密事件只含
  元数据（无 plaintext、aad、envelope、数据密钥或私钥）；策略拒绝写一条
  对应 `encrypt`/`decrypt` 的 rejected 事件（携带 key_id），成功写对应
  action 的 success 事件。备份记 `export`、恢复记 `import`，两者 `key_id`
  均为 null；恢复的所有事件（含成功）`key_id` 为 null；批量轮换整批至多
  一条 `batch_rotate` 事件，成功与拒绝终态的 `key_id` 均为 null，可按
  `action=batch_rotate` 筛选。
- `GET /v1/audit`：单一租户来源；可选 `key_id`(UUID4)、`action`、
  `limit`(1–1000，默认 100)、`cursor`。→ `{events, next_cursor}`，按
  (timestamp, event_id) 升序；游标为 HMAC 签名令牌，绑定租户/筛选/快照，
  被篡改或条件变化为 `400`。查询成功不记账，被策略拒绝才记一条
  `audit/rejected`（key_id null）。
- 账本为数据目录 `audit.log`（每行一个 JSON，只追加，进程内锁 +
  `audit.log.lock` fcntl 串行并 fsync，seq 单调）。变更走 outbox 事务：密钥
  /策略文件先携带待提交事件原子落盘 → 耐久追加账本（提交点）→ 清标记；账本
  失败回滚文件并删除本次新建句柄，返回 `500`（CLI `1`）；崩溃后启动按标记/
  event_id 幂等补记或回滚，不重不漏。恢复是多文件 outbox（标记带
  `"_restore":true` 与写集清单），只追加一条 `import` 事件；批量轮换是多
  key outbox（标记带 `"_batch_rotate":true`、写集 key_ids 与 provision/
  snapshot 引用），只追加一条 `batch_rotate` 事件（`key_id` null）。

## 命令行

所有子命令除 `serve` 外都需 `--operator`，租户命令需 `--tenant-id`；输出为
单行 JSON，字段与对应 HTTP 响应一致。

```bash
# 密钥
python -m keymgr gen      --tenant-id t --algorithm RSA2048 --label k --operator alice
python -m keymgr show     --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
python -m keymgr current  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
python -m keymgr version  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --version 1 --operator alice
python -m keymgr rotate   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --algorithm AES256 \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key rotate-0001
python -m keymgr batch-rotate --tenant-id t --operator alice \
                          --idempotency-key batch-0001 \
                          --items '[{"key_id":"<id1>","algorithm":"AES256"},{"key_id":"<id2>","algorithm":"RSA2048"}]'
python -m keymgr revoke   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --reason r --operator alice
python -m keymgr status   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
# 导出/导入、备份/恢复
python -m keymgr export   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --passphrase pw --operator alice
# 信封加密/解密（plaintext/aad 为 base64，version 缺省 current）
python -m keymgr encrypt  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> \
                          --plaintext <base64> [--aad <base64>] [--version 1] \
                          --operator alice
python -m keymgr decrypt  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> \
                          --envelope <keymgr-envelope-v1-base64> [--aad <base64>] \
                          --operator alice
python -m keymgr import   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key import-0001
python -m keymgr backup   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --operator alice
python -m keymgr restore  --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key restore-0001
# 审计 / 操作 / 策略
python -m keymgr audit    --tenant-id t --action rotate --limit 100 --operator alice
python -m keymgr operation --tenant-id t --operator alice --operation-id <id>
python -m keymgr policy --operator admin set|show|delete --tenant-id t [--rules '<json>']
```

## KMS/HSM 提供者

- 工厂返回对象须有非空 `provider_id`、`capabilities`
  （algorithms 含 AES256/RSA2048；operations 含
  generate/rotate/import_material/export_material/delete）及这五个方法。
  generate/rotate/import_material → `{handle, public_key, encrypted_material}`；
  export_material(handle) → `{public_key, encrypted_material}`；delete(handle)
  幂等。模块缺失/工厂失败/契约不符/后端异常一律 `503`（CLI `1`），固定文案
  "key management provider is unavailable"，绝不回退；导入材料不符算法（AES
  非 32 字节、RSA 公私钥不匹配等）为 `400`，错误只指名字段。
- 本地提供者用 `local.dek`(0600) 以 AES-256-GCM 包装材料，句柄与包装材料登
  记在 `local-registry.json`(0600)；密钥文件每个版本只存
  `{provider_id, handle, encrypted_material}` 三元组，导出包/备份包版本额外
  带 `provider` 来源块，旧 `keymgr-export-v1` 包无来源块时按本地处理。
- 轮换/导出/导入/恢复必须命中记录登记的 provider：记录属于未激活提供者，或
  导入/恢复来源块与当前提供者不符，均 `503`，不静默切换。
- 启动时安全扫描旧记录：仅当本地提供者活动时，把裸 `private_material`/空句
  柄的旧版本校验并包装为本地对象，先包装后原子重写，失败保持原文件字节不
  变（新建句柄随即释放，不影响启动）；配置了外部提供者时启动与普通读取既不
  加载提供者也不改写旧记录（此类记录在导出/轮换时 `503`）。

## 持久化与限制

- 每个密钥为数据目录下 `<key_id>.json`（0600，fsync + 原子 rename），含
  append-only `versions` 与 `current_version`；轮换在 per-key 进程内锁 +
  `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 锁下读改写，并发不丢版本、不悬指针。
- 导入/恢复/批量轮换在提供者调用前先建按 event_id 命名的 provision journal

  provider_id 与句柄）；提交后句柄归记录所有并删除 journal，未提交（冲突、
  提供者故障、账本失败、崩溃）则幂等删除全部已铸句柄，不留孤儿后端对象。恢复

  提交；不一致即保留全部现场等待处理。批量

- 旧 restore 记录可能没有 provision journal：未提交回滚时以 `_restore` 标记

3	The rotate / import / restore endpoints accept an ``Idempotency-Key`` header
4	(CLI: ``--idempotency-key``). One key, scoped by tenant and operator, is bound
5	to exactly one operation: its canonical request (path and normalized body) and
6	its outcome (HTTP status and response body). A retried request presenting the
7	same binding replays the stored status/response without any side effect; the
8	same key with a different binding is a conflict that names the original
9	``operation_id``.
10	
11	Each operation has an RFC 4122 UUID4 ``operation_id`` (used verbatim as the
12	operation's audit ``event_id``) and moves through ``pending`` ->
13	``succeeded`` / ``failed`` / ``conflict`` / ``timed_out``. Records persist in
14	``operations/<operation_id>.json`` (0600); the idempotency-key index
15	``operations/index.json`` maps a scoped key to its operation_id. All
16	read-modify-write of the index is serialized by one in-process lock plus an
17	exclusive ``fcntl`` lock on ``operations.lock``, so two concurrent requests
18	carrying the same key (across threads or processes) can never both execute:
19	exactly one begins, the other finds the pending binding and waits.
20	
21	A process that dies while an operation is pending is repaired on the next
22	open via :meth:`OperationStore.recover_pending`: when the operation's audit
23	event (named after the operation_id) reached the ledger the operation
24	committed and the supplied resolver rebuilds its response; otherwise the
25	operation never committed and is recorded as failed. The half-finished key
26	files and provider handles themselves are reaped by the store/coordinator
27	outbox recovery, which must run first.
28	"""
29	
30	import hashlib
31	import json
32	import os
33	import tempfile
34	import threading
35	import time
36	import uuid
37	from typing import Callable, NamedTuple, Optional

39	try:  # fcntl is POSIX-only; idempotency still works without cross-process locks.
40	    import fcntl
41	except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - non-POSIX platforms
42	    fcntl = None

44	# Operation states.
45	STATUS_PENDING = "pending"
46	STATUS_SUCCEEDED = "succeeded"
47	STATUS_FAILED = "failed"
48	STATUS_CONFLICT = "conflict"
49	STATUS_TIMED_OUT = "timed_out"
50	
51	_DIR_NAME = "operations"
52	_INDEX_NAME = "index.json"
53	_LOCK_NAME = "operations.lock"

55	# A concurrent, same-key request waits at most this long for the in-flight
56	# owner to reach a terminal state; beyond that it answers timed_out (503 / CLI
57	# 1) without writing any key, audit event or provider handle.
58	LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS = 5.0
59	_POLL_SECONDS = 0.02

62	def is_valid_idempotency_key(value) -> bool:
63	    """Validate an Idempotency-Key: 1-128 chars from the unreserved ASCII set.
64	
65	    The permitted alphabet is RFC 3986 unreserved characters:
66	    ``A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -``.
67	    """
68	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not 1 <= len(value) <= 128:
69	        return False
70	    for ch in value:
71	        if not (
72	            "A" <= ch <= "Z"
73	            or "a" <= ch <= "z"
74	            or "0" <= ch <= "9"
75	            or ch in "._~-"
76	        ):
77	            return False
78	    return True

81	def state_for_http_status(http_status: int) -> str:
82	    """Map a terminal response's HTTP status to its operation state.
83	
84	    201 is the only success; an explicit request conflict (409) is the
85	    "conflict" state. Every other terminal refusal (400/403/404) or backend
86	    failure (500/503) records as "failed". A crash-recovered operation whose
87	    audit event is durable therefore lands in the same state the original
88	    request would have, including a reconstructed rejection.
89	    """
90	    if http_status == 201:
91	        return STATUS_SUCCEEDED
92	    if http_status == 409:
93	        return STATUS_CONFLICT
94	    return STATUS_FAILED

97	# The audit action each operation kind commits with.
98	_KIND_ACTIONS = {
99	    "rotate": "rotate",
100	    "batch_rotate": "batch_rotate",
101	    "import": "import",
102	    "restore": "import",
103	}

106	def _event_matches_operation(record: "OperationRecord", event) -> bool:
107	    """Whether a durable ledger event is THIS operation's commit event.
108	
109	    Crash recovery decides committed-vs-not purely from the ledger, but the
110	    event id alone is not enough: a durable event whose tenant, action or
111	    outcome disagrees with the operation's recorded context belongs to a
112	    different mutation that happens to carry the same id, and must not
113	    finalize this operation either way. The tenant must always match the
114	    operation record; the action/outcome are checked against the staged
115	    terminal audit descriptor when one exists, else the event must be a
116	    success whose action fits the operation kind (when the kind is known).
117	    """
118	    if event.tenant_id != record.tenant_id:
119	        return False
120	    details = record.details or {}
121	    audit_desc = details.get("audit")
122	    if isinstance(audit_desc, dict):
123	        action = audit_desc.get("action")
124	        if isinstance(action, str) and action and event.action != action:
125	            return False
126	        outcome = audit_desc.get("outcome")
127	        if isinstance(outcome, str) and outcome and event.outcome != outcome:
128	            return False
129	        return True
130	    if event.outcome != "success":
131	        return False
132	    expected = _KIND_ACTIONS.get(details.get("kind"))
133	    if expected is not None and event.action != expected:
134	        return False
135	    return True

138	def normalize_body(body: Optional[dict]) -> str:
139	    """Canonical JSON form of a request body for binding comparison.
140	
141	    Keys are sorted and compact separators are used so bodies that differ only
142	    in key order or whitespace bind as the same request; a semantically
143	    different body binds differently and therefore conflicts.
144	    """
145	    return json.dumps(
146	        body if body is not None else {},
147	        sort_keys=True,
148	        separators=(",", ":"),
149	        ensure_ascii=False,
150	    )

153	class BeginResult(NamedTuple):
154	    """Outcome of :meth:`OperationStore.begin`.

156	    ``kind`` is one of ``"new"`` (the caller owns and must execute the
157	    operation), ``"replay"`` (a finished operation to replay) or
158	    ``"conflict"`` (the key is bound to a different request). A ``"replay"``
159	    may still be ``pending``; the caller waits via :meth:`await_terminal`.

166	class OperationRecord:
167	    """One persisted idempotent operation."""
168	
169	    def __init__(
170	        self,
171	        operation_id: str,
172	        tenant_id: str,
173	        operator_id: str,
174	        path: str,
175	        request_body: str,
176	        idempotency_key: str,
177	        status: str = STATUS_PENDING,
178	        http_status: Optional[int] = None,
179	        response: Optional[dict] = None,
180	        created_at: Optional[str] = None,
181	        updated_at: Optional[str] = None,
182	        details: Optional[dict] = None,
183	        mirror_required: bool = False,
184	    ) -> None:
185	        self.operation_id = operation_id
186	        self.tenant_id = tenant_id
187	        self.operator_id = operator_id
188	        self.path = path
189	        self.request_body = request_body
190	        self.idempotency_key = idempotency_key
191	        self.status = status
192	        self.http_status = http_status
193	        self.response = response
194	        self.created_at = created_at
195	        self.updated_at = updated_at
196	        # Mutation-specific facts the executor stashes before it runs, so a
197	        # crash-recovery resolver can rebuild the committed response without
198	        # the original request (e.g. a restore's write set).
199	        self.details = details
200	        # Whether this binding is of the mirrored generation: its 0600
201	        # artifact mirror is created after the bind and before the first
202	        # provider call. A pending operation of this generation whose mirror
203	        # is missing is a RETRYABLE strand (the mirror creation failed or the
204	        # process crashed right there), never a guessable failed(500). Old
205	        # records without the flag keep the legacy recovery rules -- a mirror
206	        # is never mandatory for them.
207	        self.mirror_required = mirror_required

209	    # The operation_id is the audit event_id of the mutation it wraps, so the
210	    # two subsystems resolve a crash by the same identifier.
211	    @property
212	    def event_id(self) -> str:
213	        return self.operation_id

216	        return {
217	            "operation_id": self.operation_id,
218	            "tenant_id": self.tenant_id,
219	            "operator_id": self.operator_id,
220	            "path": self.path,
221	            "request_body": self.request_body,
222	            "idempotency_key": self.idempotency_key,
223	            "status": self.status,
224	            "http_status": self.http_status,
225	            "response": self.response,
226	            "created_at": self.created_at,
227	            "updated_at": self.updated_at,
228	            "details": self.details,
229	            "mirror_required": self.mirror_required,
230	        }

232	    @classmethod
233	    def from_json(cls, data: dict) -> "OperationRecord":
234	        return cls(
235	            operation_id=data["operation_id"],
236	            tenant_id=data["tenant_id"],
237	            operator_id=data["operator_id"],
238	            path=data["path"],
239	            request_body=data.get("request_body", ""),
240	            idempotency_key=data.get("idempotency_key", ""),
241	            status=data.get("status", STATUS_PENDING),
242	            http_status=data.get("http_status"),
243	            response=data.get("response"),
244	            created_at=data.get("created_at"),
245	            updated_at=data.get("updated_at"),
246	            details=data.get("details"),
247	            mirror_required=bool(data.get("mirror_required", False)),

250	    def is_terminal(self) -> bool:
251	        return self.status in (
252	            STATUS_SUCCEEDED,
253	            STATUS_FAILED,
254	            STATUS_CONFLICT,
255	            STATUS_TIMED_OUT,
256	        )

258	    def same_binding(self, tenant_id: str, operator_id: str,
259	                     path: str, request_body: str) -> bool:
260	        """Whether a request is the identical binding this op recorded."""
261	        return (
262	            self.tenant_id == tenant_id
263	            and self.operator_id == operator_id
264	            and self.path == path
265	            and self.request_body == request_body

268	    def to_status_response(self) -> dict:
269	        """Body of GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}.
270	
271	        A pending operation exposes neither http_status nor response.
272	        """
273	        pending = self.status == STATUS_PENDING
274	        return {
275	            "operation_id": self.operation_id,
276	            "tenant_id": self.tenant_id,
277	            "status": self.status,
278	            "http_status": None if pending else self.http_status,
279	            "response": None if pending else self.response,

283	class OperationStore:
284	    """Persistent idempotent-operation records and key bindings."""
285	
286	    def __init__(self, data_dir: str, audit_log=None) -> None:
287	        self.data_dir = data_dir
288	        self.dir_path = os.path.join(data_dir, _DIR_NAME)
289	        os.makedirs(self.dir_path, exist_ok=True)
290	        self._index_path = os.path.join(self.dir_path, _INDEX_NAME)
291	        self._lock_path = os.path.join(self.data_dir, _LOCK_NAME)
292	        self._index_lock = threading.Lock()
293	        if audit_log is not None:
294	            self.audit = audit_log
295	        else:  # Import lazily-to-wire the concrete ledger without a cycle here.
296	            from .audit import AuditLog
297	
298	            self.audit = AuditLog(data_dir)
299	
300	    # -- paths / locking ---------------------------------------------------
301	    def _path_for(self, operation_id: str) -> str:
302	        return os.path.join(self.dir_path, operation_id + ".json")
303	
304	    def _locked(self):
305	        """Take the in-process lock and the cross-process fcntl lock."""
306	        self._index_lock.acquire()
307	        if fcntl is None:  # pragma: no cover - non-POSIX platforms
308	            return -1
309	        fd = os.open(self._lock_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o600)
310	        try:
311	            fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
312	        except OSError:
313	            os.close(fd)
314	            self._index_lock.release()
315	            raise
316	        return fd
317	
318	    def _unlocked(self, fd: int) -> None:
319	        try:
320	            if fcntl is not None and fd >= 0:  # pragma: no branch - POSIX
321	                fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
322	                os.close(fd)
323	        finally:
324	            self._index_lock.release()
325	
326	    def _write_atomic(self, path: str, payload: dict) -> None:
327	        fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=self.dir_path, suffix=".tmp")
328	        try:
329	            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
330	                json.dump(payload, fh)
331	                fh.flush()
332	                os.fsync(fh.fileno())
333	            os.chmod(tmp_path, 0o600)
334	            os.replace(tmp_path, path)
335	        except BaseException:
336	            try:
337	                os.unlink(tmp_path)
338	            except OSError:
339	                pass
340	            raise
341	
342	    def _write_record(self, record: OperationRecord) -> None:
343	        self._write_atomic(self._path_for(record.operation_id), record.to_json())
344	
345	    def _read_record(self, operation_id: str) -> Optional[OperationRecord]:
346	        try:
347	            with open(self._path_for(operation_id), "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
348	                data = json.load(fh)
349	        except (OSError, ValueError):
350	            return None
351	        try:
352	            return OperationRecord.from_json(data)
353	        except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
354	            return None
355	
356	    def _scope(self, tenant_id: str, operator_id: str, key: str) -> str:
357	        # The Idempotency-Key is globally scoped: one key value binds exactly
358	        # one operation. Tenant, operator, path and normalized body are part
359	        # of the recorded *binding*, so reusing the same key under a different
360	        # tenant/operator/path/body is detected as a different binding and
361	        # answered 409 (naming the original operation), rather than silently
362	        # treated as a fresh operation. (Tenant/operator isolation of the
363	        # stored record is still enforced independently on GET.)
364	        return hashlib.sha256(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
365	
366	    def _load_index(self) -> dict:
367	        try:
368	            with open(self._index_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
369	                data = json.load(fh)
370	        except FileNotFoundError:
371	            return {"bindings": {}}
372	        except (OSError, ValueError):
373	            return {"bindings": {}}
374	        bindings = data.get("bindings")
375	        if not isinstance(bindings, dict):
376	            return {"bindings": {}}
377	        return {"bindings": bindings}
378	
379	    # -- begin / finish ----------------------------------------------------
380	    def peek(
381	        self,
382	        tenant_id: str,
383	        operator_id: str,
384	        path: str,
385	        request_body: str,
386	        idempotency_key: str,
387	    ) -> BeginResult:
388	        """Read-only binding lookup; never creates an operation.
389	
390	        Lets a caller detect a replay/conflict *before* doing side-effect-free
391	        but expensive validation (such as decrypting a bundle). Returns
392	        ``replay`` (identical binding; the record may still be pending) or
393	        ``conflict`` (same key, different binding), or ``new`` when the key is
394	        unbound. A later :meth:`begin` remains authoritative for concurrency.
395	        """
396	        scope = self._scope(tenant_id, operator_id, idempotency_key)
397	        fd = self._locked()
398	        try:
399	            index = self._load_index()
400	            bound = index["bindings"].get(scope)
401	            if bound is None:
402	                return BeginResult("new", None)
403	            existing = self._read_record(bound)
404	            if existing is None:
405	                return BeginResult("new", None)
406	            kind = (
407	                "replay"
408	                if existing.same_binding(
409	                    tenant_id, operator_id, path, request_body
410	                )
411	                else "conflict"
412	            )
413	            return BeginResult(kind, existing)
414	        finally:
415	            self._unlocked(fd)
416	
417	    def begin(
418	        self,
419	        tenant_id: str,
420	        operator_id: str,
421	        path: str,
422	        request_body: str,
423	        idempotency_key: str,
424	    ) -> BeginResult:
425	        """Bind the key and create/return the operation for one request.
426	
427	        Under the global index lock: if the scoped key is unbound a fresh
428	        ``pending`` operation is persisted (record file first, index second)
429	        and returned as ``new``; if it is already bound the stored operation
430	        is returned as ``replay`` for an identical binding or ``conflict`` for
431	        a different one. Exactly one concurrent same-key request can win
432	        ``new``; the others observe the pending binding.
433	        """
434	        scope = self._scope(tenant_id, operator_id, idempotency_key)
435	        fd = self._locked()
436	        try:
437	            index = self._load_index()
438	            bound = index["bindings"].get(scope)
439	            if bound is not None:
440	                existing = self._read_record(bound)
441	                if existing is None:
442	                    # Index points at a missing record: treat as a fresh bind
443	                    # rather than wedging the key forever.
444	                    bound = None
445	            if bound is not None:
446	                kind = (
447	                    "replay"
448	                    if existing.same_binding(
449	                        tenant_id, operator_id, path, request_body
450	                    )
451	                    else "conflict"
452	                )
453	                return BeginResult(kind, existing)
454	
455	            from datetime import datetime, timezone
456	
457	            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
458	            operation_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
459	            record = OperationRecord(
460	                operation_id=operation_id,
461	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
462	                operator_id=operator_id,
463	                path=path,
464	                request_body=request_body,
465	                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
466	                status=STATUS_PENDING,
467	                created_at=now,
468	                updated_at=now,
469	                mirror_required=True,
470	            )
471	            self._write_record(record)
472	            index["bindings"][scope] = operation_id
473	            self._write_atomic(self._index_path, index)
474	            return BeginResult("new", record)
475	        finally:
476	            self._unlocked(fd)
477	
478	    def await_terminal(
479	        self, record: OperationRecord, timeout: float = LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS
480	    ) -> OperationRecord:
481	        """Wait for a concurrently-owned operation to finish.
482	
483	        Polls the record file until the owner records a terminal state, or
484	        until ``timeout`` elapses, in which case the still-pending record is
485	        returned (the caller answers timed_out without mutating it).
486	        """
487	        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
488	        current = record
489	        while not current.is_terminal():
490	            remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
491	            if remaining <= 0:
492	                return current
493	            time.sleep(min(_POLL_SECONDS, remaining))
494	            refreshed = self._read_record(current.operation_id)
495	            if refreshed is None:
496	                continue
497	            current = refreshed
498	        return current
499	
500	    def update_details(self, record: OperationRecord, details: dict) -> None:
501	        """Persist recovery facts on a still-pending owned operation.
502	
503	        ``details`` is merged into the already-persisted context rather than
504	        replacing it, so a terminal rejection never erases the operation kind,
505	        the exact key_id rule or other facts recorded before the business
506	        check ran. Written before the mutation runs, so a crash after the
507	        audit commit but before :meth:`finish` can still rebuild the committed
508	        response from durable context alone.
509	        """
510	        merged = dict(record.details or {})
511	        merged.update(details)
512	        record.details = merged
513	        fd = self._locked()
514	        try:
515	            self._write_record(record)
516	        finally:
517	            self._unlocked(fd)
518	
519	    def stage_terminal(
520	        self,
521	        record: OperationRecord,
522	        http_status: int,
523	        response: dict,
524	        audit: Optional[dict] = None,
525	    ) -> None:
526	        """Durably persist the exact terminal result *before* the event append.
527	
528	        The staged ``result`` (HTTP status plus the complete error/success
529	        response body) and optional ``audit`` descriptor are merged into the
530	        operation context and fsynced to the record file. Once the subsequent
531	        audit append lands, crash recovery replays this exact status/response
532	        verbatim -- never re-evaluating the policy, re-reading the object or
533	        re-decrypting the bundle. A crash before the append leaves both the
534	        stage and the event uncommitted and the operation is later finalized
535	        as failed(500).
536	        """
537	        details = dict(record.details or {})
538	        details["result"] = {
539	            "http_status": http_status,
540	            "response": response,
541	        }
542	        # Explicit terminal status mirror; also read by the legacy fallback
543	        # resolver for records predating the staged "result".
544	        details["terminal"] = http_status
545	        if audit is not None:
546	            details["audit"] = audit
547	        self.update_details(record, details)
548	
549	    def finish(
550	        self,
551	        record: OperationRecord,
552	        status: str,
553	        http_status: int,
554	        response: dict,
555	    ) -> None:
556	        """Persist the terminal state/response of an owned operation."""
557	        from datetime import datetime, timezone
558	
559	        record.status = status
560	        record.http_status = http_status
561	        record.response = response
562	        record.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
563	        fd = self._locked()
564	        try:
565	            self._write_record(record)
566	        finally:
567	            self._unlocked(fd)
568	
569	    def get(
570	        self, operation_id: str, tenant_id: str, operator_id: str
571	    ) -> Optional[OperationRecord]:
572	        """Return an operation visible to exactly one tenant and operator.
573	
574	        An unknown id, a malformed id, or an operation owned by another tenant
575	        or another operator all return None so existence never leaks.
576	        """
577	        try:
578	            if uuid.UUID(operation_id).version != 4:
579	                return None
580	        except (ValueError, AttributeError, TypeError):
581	            return None
582	        record = self._read_record(operation_id)
583	        if record is None:
584	            return None
585	        if record.tenant_id != tenant_id or record.operator_id != operator_id:
586	            return None
587	        return record
588	
589	    # -- crash recovery ----------------------------------------------------
590	    def recover_pending(
591	        self,
592	        resolve_committed: Optional[
593	            Callable[["OperationRecord", object], "tuple[int, dict]"]
594	        ] = None,
595	        is_parked: Optional[Callable[[str], bool]] = None,
596	    ) -> None:
597	        """Finish operations left pending by a crashed process.
598	
599	        Must run *after* the key-store and restore outbox recovery, so the
600	        ledger already reflects every half-committed mutation. For each
601	        pending operation: when its event reached the ledger the operation
602	        is durable and the terminal status/response persisted *with the
603	        rejection/success context* (``details["result"]``) are replayed
604	        verbatim -- the policy, the current object state and the (possibly no
605	        longer decryptable) bundle are never consulted again, so a later
606	        policy/state change cannot turn a 403 into a 404/409 or rewrite the
607	        first response; only when no result was staged (older records) does
608	        ``resolve_committed(record, event)`` rebuild a best-effort
609	        projection. When the event never reached the ledger the operation
610	        never committed and is recorded as a 500 failure (the outbox/
611	        provision recovery has already removed its half-written files and
612	        minted handles).
613	        """
614	        try:
